## Requirements (contract § In scope — deliverables)

1. **QW-11:** branded 404/403/410, favicon, canonical-only sitemap, unique
   titles + meta descriptions, `/terms` → the API terms — the `/terms`
   redirect ships only with N-7 beside it (the API's terms response is
   known-wrong until P34.46 deploys P34.25's fix — the ticket's labelled
   agent reading, recorded).
2. **Error pages' serving:** built as static pages; the nginx `error_page`
   change is P34.40's dark roll, recorded owed (`/task/` 403 → 404 per G1).
3. **QW-13:** label-in-name, unique landmark names, wrapped ids, print `main`.
4. **K14 NEW-7 / NEW-8:** no joined words at inline-element boundaries; runs
   of five or more digits grouped (four left alone; never rounded).
5. **K12b NEW-11:** the no-op `stale`/`volatility` sort routes removed until
   UX9-2 makes them real; `source`/`status` sorting preserved.
6. **Copy:** every new public sentence drafted into copy batch #1
   (`docs/build/reports/copy-batches/batch-01.md`), else only N-1…N-7 by
   sha256 (B-2).

Out of scope: publication (P34.17's republish #1, its own verbatim go); the
later W1–W4 UX rows (K13 §7.1); the capstone journeys (P37.63–64 / CAP-01).

## Plan and what landed

1. **Error pages (QW-11).** `web/src/pages/{404,403,410}.astro` render the
   real shell with `chrome="minimal"` + `noindex` (new `BaseLayout` props);
   the 410 body is N-6 verbatim (`data-notice="N-6"`). The new `sigChrome`
   build integration (`astro.config.mjs`) copies `/403/` and `/410/` to flat
   `403.html`/`410.html` beside Astro's `/404.html` — the P34.40
   `error_page` wiring then has files to point at.
2. **Favicon.** `web/public/favicon.svg` (the three-letter mark on the ink
   square) linked from `BaseLayout` + the print page.
3. **Sitemap (canonical-only).** `sigChrome` walks the emitted pages at
   `astro:build:done` and lists a URL only when it is its *own* canonical —
   print pages canonicalise to their dossier, `noindex` pages never appear,
   every loc sits on `https://surveillancegraph.org` (22 URLs in the fixture
   build). `robots.txt` gains `Sitemap:`.
4. **Unique titles + descriptions.** `BaseLayout` accepts `description`;
   `lib/meta.ts`'s template (`{title} — Surveillance Infrastructure Graph
   (SIG)`, row MD-01) derives a unique description from each unique title;
   the freshness sort route gains its own title (row `title`); the print
   page uses the same template.
5. **`/terms` (QW-11).** `terms.astro` links `apiTermsUrl()` —
   `lib/public-api.ts`'s launch-recorded base, `SIG_API_BASE_URL`-overridable
   — with N-7 verbatim beside it (`data-notice="N-7"`). A plain link on a
   noindex page: a meta-refresh would hide the notice or breach WCAG 2.2.1;
   a true 301 is the P34.40 leg in `D-P34.13-1`.
6. **QW-13.** Wordmark accessible name now contains its visible text
   (WM-01); `HowWeKnowThis` gains a visually-hidden unique suffix
   (HW-11 `— site-wide` / HW-12 `— {pageName}` / HW-13 `— this page`) so a
   dossier's two "How we know this" landmarks stop colliding (RI-49); the
   print document gains `<main id="main">`; `code` + permalink classes get
   `overflow-wrap/word-break: break-word` (DR-C4-14).
7. **K14 NEW-7.** `{" "}` separators at every tag boundary Astro's
   line-wrap collapse would glue — including real glues found by the new
   scan (`toggled):Field` on `/map/`, `Tulsa PD(preconfigured…` +
   `)evidence:` + `Safety—2 hops` on `/network/`). The data-collection
   binding test's `_norm` now unfolds `{" "}` like the P34.11 batch test.
8. **K14 NEW-8.** `lib/format.ts` `groupDigits`/`fmtInt` applied at the
   render seam (landing stats, freshness table + summary, dossier figures
   and reconciliation values).
9. **K12b NEW-11.** `COLUMNS` drops `stale`/`volatility`; `getStaticPaths`
   carries its key list locally (Astro hoists it — the first build failed
   `COLUMNS is not defined` before this was understood); sort links render
   only the two real sorts; `REMOVED_FRESHNESS_SORT_PAGES` asserts
   `/data-freshness/{stale,volatility}/` 404.
10. **Copy batch + registries.** 15 pending rows (NF-01/02, FB-01/02,
    GN-01, TR-01/02, four `title`, HW-11…13, MD-01, WM-01) bound via
    `data-copy`; the P34.11 binding test's page map + id pattern extended;
    `ops/public_routes.toml` requires the new emits; `CHROME_PAGES` joins
    `A11Y_PAGES` + `ZERO_JS_PUBLIC_PAGES` in `tests/e2e/pages.ts`.
